title: Ssense DPDP Compliance Audit Result
description: Deterministic legal audit output bridging the SLM reasoning engine to the Rust network interceptor.

global_legal_reasoning.description: Chain-of-thought reasoning analyzing the policy text against the DPDP Act and 2025 Rules before any conclusions are made.

violations.description: Specific statutory violations detected, coupled directly with their mechanical enforcement actions.

step_1_active_claim_analysis.description: Analyze the active, affirmative words in the quote to ensure they are NOT based on silence or omission.

step_2_statute_match.description: Explain how the extracted quote explicitly matches the targeted statute. Ensure there is no statute stretching or mismatch.

omission_check.description: If the violation is based on missing information or what the policy 'failed to state', set to TRUE. Otherwise FALSE.

step_3_semantic_justification.description: Explain exactly why the text extracted in step_1 constitutes a violation.

statute_reference.description: The exact Section or Rule violated (e.g., 'Section 4', 'Rule 8(3)').

evidence_quote.description: The exact verbatim string extracted from step_1.

offending_entities.description: Specific targets for the network action.
